dense.why: the head / face: long beak (proxy yellow beak x -0.32..0.34, y -2.18..-0.90, z 1.55..2.54), the forehead plate + spike (y -0.95..-0.55, z up to 3.59) and both eyes (proxy sha f147ac02 stage-1 frame); vg_weight 0.3 so the eye / spike boxes below sit denser

the -x eye (proxy dark pupil texels centre -0.517,-0.585,2.563): as the +x eye
the forehead spike (proxy height map: tip z 3.59 at x 0, y -0.8; it rises from the beak plate): held denser so the point stays sharp

recolour3d.why: tone (UNIT NOTE: 'the proxy reads darker blue than the sheet; check the texture before tinting'): run-1 basecolor blue texels (b* < -15) median 46,102,143 (L* 41.8, a* -4.5, b* -29.0; albedo 54,117,153 L* 48.0, a* -5.4) vs the sheet body blue (front 97,139,190 L* 56.7 / side 78,121,179 L* 50.3 a* +3.6 b* -34.1 / back 67,104,164 L* 44.1; chips 106,158,216 / 70,114,179): ~8 L* darker and cyan-shifted (a* -4.5 vs +3.6). Blue feather texels (L* 15..75 so the black pupils and pale eye whites / highlights are not selected; b* <= -12 so the beak / spike / feet are not) to the sheet side-body blue / 0.87 (run-1 basecolor / albedo = AO x0.87) with the proxy's feather shading kept (gamma 0.8): the chest-light / back-dark pattern stays relative

light.ao_fill_below_why: AO texels < 0.04 (bake origins between fused feather flaps where every AO ray is occluded) refilled from their valid neighbours (vulture_creature / sand_drill_worm idiom): 74632 of 1038597 covered texels
light.cuts_front_flap_why: ARTIST v1 NOTE (design/review-log.md '2026-10-16 - Spike Beak v1 note'): 'two wings  this one needs to be removed' = the FRONT wing flap behind the eye / cheek (Pixal3D's reading of the sheet FRONT view's side wings), removed on BOTH sides; the main tucked wing (front edge at proxy y ~0.1) stays. Proxy sha f147ac02. The new skin follows the BODY: per side a quadric x^2 = f(y, z) fitted on the body outside the flap zone (face front y < -0.62, the body line under the main wing y > 0.15), plus the body's own offset from it Laplace-filled in from the surrounding real body (so the skin meets the body / head / main-wing edge with no ledge; inside it sits q + 0.08 median, the measured skin under the free flap is q + 0.07). Cells (0.03 y x 0.05 z, y -0.65..0.08, z 0.95..2.6, eye / eye-ring cells z > 2.15 and y < -0.38 never) whose outer surface stands > 0.03 u above q + 0.07 are replaced: cut from 0.15 u BELOW the new skin (one box per y-column run, smooth k 0.02; the proxy faces in the box leave the bake source) and rebuilt by light.adds; never mirrored. Removed depth p50 / p95: 0.20 / 0.49 u
